page.layout: One page of text. Running head centred at top. Page number at top right. One marginal note, "NB.", in the right margin beside the first paragraph. Text in one column, with a centred heading "De Perficis." before the second paragraph.

main_text.p: NB.Verum memineris, ante alios cibos horas aliquot commanducanda esse, nec cum aliis cibis miscenda. Recentium gratia quia non diu durat, siccari solent feruariq[?], viq; ad alia nascen-tia, ad varios in re cibaria usu. Succus quicq[?] prunorum a matribus quibusdam familiis decoquitur, ad sitim febricitantium levandam, linguae, ariditatem humectandam. Diosco-ridem mirantur multi, quod scripserit, siccata Damascena alvum nequaquam devicere, cum in confessio fit ea id praestare, brodio enim seu jus culo eorum nihil fere in alio leniter laxanda frequentius.
main_text.head: De Perficis.
main_text.p: Perfica mali succi esse, ut quo deterius in cibis esse nihil possit, doctissimi quique statuunt. Plinius l. 15. c. 12. pomum Perficum innocuum esse, experique undique ab aegris aperte scripsit, Et l. 23 c. 7. Perfica utiliora esse stomacho quam pruna prodidit.

Sed a veritate eum aberrare, refellendumque propterea esse quidam contra scripserunt. Verum, quod pace illorum dixerim, innoxium esse malum Perficum aegris recte scripsisse Plinium sentio, in ardentibus enim febribus ob qualitatem frigidam & hu-

page.notes: The first word of the page, "Verum", is a continuation from the previous page. The dropcap "P" of "Perfica" is printed as a large initial and was joined to the word. Doubtful readings: "quicq" (possibly "quoq;") and "feruariq" are marked [?]. "experique" is hard to read in the scan. The text ends with the broken word "hu-", which continues on the next page. The signature "T s" is taken from the foot of the page. The running head is taken as "PROROGANDA.".
